component.name: BrosLauncher
component.summary: Virtual machine launcher for Bros OS testing

description.p: BrosLauncher is a graphical application for launching and testing Bros OS in a QEMU virtual machine environment. It provides an intuitive interface for configuring CPU, memory, and storage settings while displaying real-time CPU schematic visualization.

ul.li: Configurable CPU cores, frequency, RAM, and storage

description.p: Improved QEMU availability checking and error handling.
